final_candidate_map.text:
I made a five-stage map for myself from all of this. Some of the pieces have direct research behind them; the way I've put them into five stages is my own and still provisional.

1. Child alone — get oriented to the present and make things around you safe enough to begin.
2. Borrowed adult — that's the part we were just talking about. The adult may be someone who's actually there, somebody you remember or imagine, or a symbolic figure.
3. Adult apprentice — do one part of the caring yourself while the support is still there.
4. Inner adult — keep practicing warmth, protection, and direction until they're easier to call up when you need them.
5. Adult and child in relationship — the adult leads without pushing the child away, and the child doesn't have to run the whole life alone. “I am still this child, and I am also becoming the adult who stays.”
